snippet.title: Cleanup on Aisle 3: See How Long You Survive
snippet.description:
You're hired. This is an opportunity.

Cleanup on Aisle 3 is a solo arcade management game about running an entire grocery store by yourself. It starts manageable. It does not stay that way, because every night corporate approves exactly one improvement, and the store gets bigger, busier and louder while the help stays exactly as useless as it was on day one.

Think PlateUp, but the kitchen is a supermarket and the ticket rush never stops.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4971070/Cleanup_on_Aisle_3/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=storepage_launch&utm_content=trailer_desc

- Scan for combos at the register
- Wind up and throw crates clear across the store to restock shelves
- Wrangle five-cart trains across a growing parking lot
- Survive 14 days of nightly corporate directives that never actually help

More at aviaryinteractive.com
